text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Russian newspapers this morning. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
SEVODNYA
- First deputy prime minister Anatoly Chubais is trying to reorganise the government administration, the stronghold of bureaucracy which is holding up reforms in the country.
- Federal authorities will finance only those regions of Russia which start communal reform, said the first deputy prime minister Boris Nemtsov.
- Moscow authorities are to tighten sanitary regulations for street vendors.
- Vladimir Yakovlev, mayor of St Petersburg, and Boris Khait, president of Most Bank, have discussed the idea of creating their own Wall Street in Russia's second city.
- The Coca Cola Co. has accused one of Russian mineral water producers of using the Fanta brand name. The Goryachy Klyuch company denies the accusations.
- The president of Rosneft may be replaced in order to put an end to speculation about a merger of several companies to create a state-run holding.
KOMMERSANT DAILY
- A conflict between the Russian newspaper Izvestia and the oil company Lukoil which owns a 41 percent stake of the papers shares is just a routine disagreement between shareholders and directors.
- During talks with Russia's foreign minister on NATO expansion, I will try to base my position on the Helsinki summit achievements, NATO Secretary General Javier Solana told the paper.
- Anatoly Chubais suggested the Central Bank and Federal Securities Commission should resolve their conflict within three weeks.
- Unemployment in Russia may double by the end of the year.
- Reforms in the Russian government have opened access to the military-industrial complex for private capital.
NEZAVISIMAYA GAZETA
- It is time to deepen relations between Russia and China, before the Beijing leadership is replaced by a younger, western-oriented generation, says Sergei Shakhrai, a prominent Russian politician.
- According to Alexander Pochinok, new head of the State Tax Service, income tax for individuals will be lowered, whereas commercial banks will have to pay more for servicing the federal budget.
ROSSIISKAYA GAZETA
- A unique air-space system Burlak-Diana is being designed in Russia.
SOVIETSKAYA ROSSIA
- Russia will be great and socialist, says Gennady Zyuganov, the leader of Russia's Communist Party.
KOMSOMOLSKAYA PRAVDA
- There is a great deal of hypocrisy in a widely publicised idea that a new generation has come to power in Russia. Nothing has really changed.
-- Svetlana Kovaleva, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
